decisions.Kwic: No.2077大鑑下第十世卷第一目錄續傳燈錄卷第一目錄大鑑下第十世汝州首山念禪師法嗣一十六人汾陽善昭禪師葉

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The headword occurs inside the compound title 續傳燈錄 in the document identifier, volume title, and contents heading before the lineage list and before Fenyang Shanzhao's biography begins. These are title noun phrases with no speech marker or human subject, so the occurrence is editorial textual metadata rather than a master's spoken turn.

Decision.AttributionNote: Continuation of the Lamp Record (續傳燈錄). The lamp-record title and contents heading repeats the work and volume title before listing Shoushan Xingnian's sixteen heirs and beginning Fenyang Shanzhao's biography. It is impersonal textual metadata, not speech by Juding or any other master.

decisions.Kwic: 逢佛殺佛逢祖殺祖逢羅漢殺羅漢。既稱善知識。為什麼却要殺人去。且道是什麼道理。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continuation of the Lamp Record (續傳燈錄), Dahui Zonggao biography. The immediately governing introduction says, 'therefore Master Linji said' (所以臨濟和尚道); Linji Yixuan is the exact quoted speaker of 'meeting a buddha, kill the buddha; meeting a patriarch, kill the patriarch; meeting an arhat, kill the arhat.' Dahui Zonggao then asks why a good teacher would want to kill people and what the principle is.
